title: Do “Little Emperors” Get More Than “Little Empresses”? Boy-Girl Gender Discrimination as Evidenced by Consumption Behavior of Chinese Households
authors: Lin Chen; Yuxin Chen; Jeongwen Chiang; Yufei Zhang
eligible_reason: Within-household boy-vs-girl spending comparisons: paired t-tests and one-way ANOVA by city tier (Tables 3-7) and a cross-sectional district-level OLS of discrimination ratios on city size and demographics (Table 8). The 'difference-in-differences' language refers to boy-girl differences across city tiers, not a panel with staggered treatment.
design_notes: SPSS syntax for Tables 3-7 (ONEWAY, paired T-TEST split by rural tier and festival month); Stata Table 8 code file.do: reg RatioBG/gd_qty/gd_order on mediumcities smallcities and district covariates, robust.
software_notes: SPSS for Tables 3-7, Stata for Table 8.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. No staggered design.
